name: Farmer Carry

instructions.description: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with shoulders relaxed.
Brace your trunk and walk forward with short controlled steps and an upright posture.
Keep the weights close to your sides and avoid leaning or shrugging.
Turn carefully if needed and set the weights down with a hip hinge when the carry is complete.

performanceMetrics.notes: Measure total walking distance with upright posture.
Record the load carried in each hand or total load.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Carry one weight on one side to increase anti-lateral-flexion demand.

commentsNotes: Do not rush the walk if grip or posture breaks down.
Use a clear path without obstacles.
